answers.moment: When Liam told me about the graphics card. He buys broken electronics on Marketplace and fixes them to sell on. He paid ninety pounds for one, the fan was dead, a new fan cost a fiver, and he will sell it for two hundred and fifty. I asked if the seller knew. He said no.
answers.reason: It sat uncomfortably with me. I wouldn't want that in my books, business or not.
